Retail Delivery Fee Rates

The Retail Delivery Fee is made up of six different fees. The rates are listed below. The retail delivery fee may increase each July to adjust for inflation.

Per statute, the Department is annually required to publish the new rate by April 15 for the upcoming rate effective in July.
